question: Where does the landed ECC2K-130 index-calculus cold query spend instructions, before changing half-trace table construction?

claims.text: Descriptive absolute instruction hotspots for one unmodified fixed cold query; no comparison or performance gain claim.

arms.description: Unchanged landed adjoint solver in the source-identical retained executable

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: One executable, exact current solver snapshot and adjoint candidate, same actual numeric dependencies and pinned unexecuted SAT support; all projector construction charged.

factors.name: instances
factors.how: Six disclosed prior d12 cases. Identical compact single-query payload on every arm; eight hashes include the two additional positive pilot targets. No old all-workload parser result is used as a new arm.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Rotate three arms by field/kind/repetition; five rounds.

factors.name: threads
factors.how: Single-threaded native solver; one CPU allocation and2GiB process address-space ceiling for the proposed local exception.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Intel Xeon Platinum8573C x86 virtual host; CPU0; simulated instructions only; no cross-host ratio or native-time claim.

factors.name: cache_and_layout
factors.how: Fresh native and Callgrind process for every arm/query; lazy symbolic context fixed; no free reusable projector.

factors.name: preemption
factors.how: Outer600second total guard, no retries; raw process output and flushed JSONL prefixes retained.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Compiled deterministic summary is hashed before affected data, with no adaptive sample selection or population inference.

comparisons.threshold: Nonzero observed whole-process Ir and successful original fixed-query result; no gain criterion.

seed_derivation.note: Reuse exact fixed prior65-case workload; primary selection explicitly n83/131,d12,distinct-planted-0/uniform/cancellation.

instance_sampling.rule: Reuse exact fixed prior65-case workload; primary selection explicitly n83/131,d12,distinct-planted-0/uniform/cancellation.

power.note: One descriptive deterministic profile; no statistical test or population power claim.

inadmissible: No timing, scaling, population, full-DLP or challenge-recovery claim.
UNKNOWN is not UNSAT; no row deletion, adaptive seeds or comparison of unpaired favorable subsets.
Native group counters exclude field/ANF, non-group inversions and SAT work; they are not a complete cost unit.

literature.claim: General half-trace calls already use a cached map; the remaining cold setup constructs basis images by squaring chains.
Artin-Schreier map is F2-linear with image the trace-zero hyperplane. Supports testing a normalized inverse; no novelty claim.

extensions.authorization: Persistent explicit local CPU0/2GiB/600second/zero-paid envelope; separate absolute diagnostic before comparative panel.
extensions.source_identity: Every retained numerical/harness input remains byte-identical on current main; fresh profile is not an old-host ratio.
